panels.title: Policy req/s
panels.description: Total policy request throughput across REST, Dovecot, and Postfix TCP sources.

panels.title: Reject share
panels.description: Share of policy decisions that reject mail in the selected time window.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx req/s
panels.description: Server-side REST errors. The metrics endpoint is intentionally not self-instrumented.

panels.title: Active TCP
panels.description: Currently active TCP policy-service connections.

panels.title: Decision rate by outcome
panels.description: Low-cardinality policy outcomes such as accept, reject, whitelist, info, empty, and error.

panels.title: Policy latency p95 / p99
panels.description: Histogram quantiles for end-to-end policy evaluation by source.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, source) (rate(geoip_policyd_policy_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, source) (rate(geoip_policyd_policy_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", source=~"$source"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Policy source mix
panels.description: Throughput split between REST query, Dovecot policy, and Postfix TCP sources.

panels.title: Decision totals in range
panels.description: Policy outcomes accumulated over the active Grafana time range.

panels.title: HTTP route rate
panels.description: REST route traffic by normalized route and status class.

panels.title: HTTP route latency p95
panels.description: HTTP handler p95 duration by normalized route.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, path) (rate(geoip_policyd_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", path=~"$route"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: GeoIP lookup rate
panels.description: GeoIP lookups by result: hit, miss, invalid, unavailable, and error.

panels.title: GeoIP lookup p95
panels.description: GeoIP lookup duration p95 by result.

panels.title: CDB lookup rate
panels.description: CDB lookup activity for policy data.

panels.title: GeoIP reloads in range
panels.description: Manual or operator-triggered GeoIP reload attempts over the dashboard range.

panels.title: CDB lookup p95
panels.description: CDB lookup duration p95 by result.

panels.title: Operator action rate
panels.description: Operator action executions by action name and result.

panels.title: Redis operation rate
panels.description: Redis commands, pipelines, and dials by role, operation, and result.

panels.title: Redis latency p95
panels.description: Top Redis operation p95 latencies by role and operation.

targets.expr: topk(10, histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, role, operation) (rate(geoip_policyd_redis_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))))

panels.title: LDAP operation rate
panels.description: LDAP connect, bind, search, and user_check activity by result.

panels.title: LDAP latency p95
panels.description: LDAP operation p95 duration by operation.

panels.title: LDAP pool connections
panels.description: LDAP pool state gauges as reported by the runtime.

panels.title: TCP connection events
panels.description: TCP policy-service accept and close events by result.

panels.title: TCP active connections
panels.description: Active TCP policy-service connections over time.

panels.description: Optional Go runtime collectors. Enable with --prometheus-runtime-metrics.

panels.description: Optional process RSS and virtual memory. Enable with --prometheus-runtime-metrics.

panels.description: Optional process CPU rate and file-descriptor usage. Enable with --prometheus-runtime-metrics.
